desc.zh-CN: GPT-4-Turbo 是 OpenAI 出品的 API 模型，具体使用的版本号为 gpt-4-1106-preview
desc.en-US: GPT-4-Turbo is an API model produced by OpenAI, with the specific version number being gpt-4-1106-preview.

desc.zh-CN: Claude3-Opus 是 Anthropic 出品的第三代 Claude 模型，该系列包含 Haiku, Sonnet 和 Opus 三个模型，其中 Opus 是其中能力最强的模型。Claude3-Opus 与 Claude2 的服务响应速度类似。
desc.en-US: Claude3-Opus is the third generation Claude model by Anthropic, including three models in the series: Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus, with Opus being the most capable. Claude3-Opus has a service response speed similar to Claude2.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-4 是智谱 AI 出品的 API 模型，参数量超过千亿量级。该模型会进行周期性版本迭代
desc.en-US: GLM-4 is an API model from Zhipu AI, with a parameter count exceeding the hundred billion scale. This model undergoes periodic version iterations.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen-Max 是阿里巴巴出品的 API 模型，此为 0107 版本
desc.en-US: Qwen-Max is an API model produced by Alibaba. This is version 0107

desc.zh-CN: Qwen-Max 是阿里巴巴出品的 API 模型，此为 0403 版本
desc.en-US: Qwen-Max is an API model produced by Alibaba. This is version 0403

desc.zh-CN: Qwen1.5 是 Qwen2 的测试版，保持了作为仅解码器的变换模型架构，拥有 SwiGLU 激活函数、 RoPE 和多头注意力机制，拥有六种模型大小，增强了多语言和聊天模型能力，支持 32768 令牌的上下文长度，所有模型均启用了系统提示以实现角色扮演，代码支持 transformers 原生实现。
desc.en-US: Qwen1.5 is the beta version of Qwen2, maintaining its architecture as a decoder-only transformer model with SwiGLU activation, RoPE, and multi-head attention mechanisms. It offers six model sizes and has enhanced multilingual and chat model capabilities, supporting a context length of 32,768 tokens. All models have enabled system prompts for roleplaying, and the code supports native implementation in transformers.

desc.zh-CN: Erniebot-pro 是百度出品的 API 模型
desc.en-US: Erniebot-pro is an API model produced by Baidu.

desc.zh-CN: UniGPT 山海大模型是由云知声出品的 API 模型
desc.en-US: UniGPT model is an API model produced by Unisound.

desc.zh-CN: Mistral-Large 是由 Mistral 出品的 API 模型，该系列有 Small, Medium, Large 三个模型，其中 Large 是最大的
desc.en-US: Mistral-Large is an API model by Mistral, with three models in the series: Small, Medium, Large, with Large being the largest.

desc.zh-CN: 通义千问-72B（Qwen-72B）是阿里云研发的通义千问大模型系列的720亿参数规模的模型。Qwen-72B是基于Transformer的大语言模型, 在超大规模的预训练数据上进行训练得到。预训练数据类型多样，覆盖广泛，包括大量网络文本、专业书籍、代码等。同时，在Qwen-72B的基础上，我们使用对齐机制打造了基于大语言模型的AI助手Qwen-72B-Chat。通义千问-72B（Qwen-72B）主要有以下特点：大规模高质量训练语料，强大的性能，覆盖更全面的词表，较长的上下文支持。
desc.en-US: Qwen-72B is the 72B-parameter version of the large language model series, Qwen (abbr. Tongyi Qianwen), proposed by Alibaba Cloud. Qwen-72B is a Transformer-based large language model, which is pretrained on a large volume of data, including web texts, books, codes, etc. Additionally, based on the pretrained Qwen-72B, we release Qwen-72B-Chat, a large-model-based AI assistant, which is trained with alignment techniques. The features of Qwen-72B include: Large-scale high-quality training corpora, Competitive performance, More comprehensive vocabulary coverage, and Longer context support.

desc.zh-CN: abab5 是 MiniMax 出品的 API 模型
desc.en-US: abab5 is an API model produced by MiniMax.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen1.5 是 Qwen2 的测试版，保持了作为仅解码器的变换模型架构，拥有 SwiGLU 激活函数、 RoPE 和多头注意力机制，拥有六种模型大小，增强了多语言和聊天模型能力，支持 32768 令牌的上下文长度，所有模型均启用了系统提示以实现角色扮演，代码支持 transformers 原生实现。
desc.en-US: Qwen1.5 is the beta version of Qwen2, maintaining its architecture as a decoder-only transformer model with SwiGLU activation, RoPE, and multi-head attention mechanisms. It offers six model sizes and has enhanced multilingual and chat model capabilities, supporting a context length of 32,768 tokens. All models have enabled system prompts for roleplaying, and the code supports native implementation in transformers.

desc.zh-CN: InternLM2是第二代浦语模型，InternLM2 包含两种模型规格：7B 和 20B
desc.en-US: The second generation of the InternLM model, InternLM2, includes models at two scales: 7B and 20B.

desc.zh-CN: Yi系列模型是由01.AI的开发者从头开始训练的大型语言模型。首次公开发布包括两个双语（英语/中文）基础模型，参数规模分别为60亿和340亿。这两个模型都采用了4000个序列长度进行训练，并且在推理时可以扩展到32000个序列长度。
desc.en-US: The Yi series models are large language models trained from scratch by developers at 01.AI. The first public release contains two bilingual (English/Chinese) base models with the parameter sizes of 6B and 34B. Both of them are trained with 4K sequence length and can be extended to 32K during inference time.

desc.zh-CN: GPT-3.5-Turbo 是 OpenAI 出品的 API 模型，具体使用的版本号为 gpt-3.5-turbo-0613
desc.en-US: GPT-3.5-Turbo is an API model produced by OpenAI, with the specific version number being gpt-3.5-turbo-0613.

desc.zh-CN: OrionStar-Yi-34B-Chat 是猎户星空基于零一万物开源的Yi-34B模型，使用 15W+ 的高质量语料训练而来微调大模型，旨在为大模型社区用户提供卓越的交互体验。
desc.en-US: OrionStar-Yi-34B-Chat from OrionStarAI is based on the open-source Yi-34B model, fine-tuned on a high-quality corpus of over 15 million sentences. OrionStar-Yi-34B-Chat aims to provide an excellent interactive experience for users in the large model community.

desc.zh-CN: Baichuan2-Turbo 是百川智能出品的 API 模型
desc.en-US: Baichuan2-Turbo is an API model produced by Baichuan Intelligence.

desc.zh-CN: DBRX-Instruct 是由 DataBricks 从零开始训练得到的 MoE 模型。该模型推理中的采用 16 专家选 4 的方案，激活参数量为 36B。预训练 token 数为 12T，支持 32K 上下文
desc.en-US: DBRX-Instruct is an MoE model trained from scratch by DataBricks, utilizing a selection scheme of 16 experts choosing 4, with an active parameter count of 36B. It's pretrained on 12T tokens, supporting a 32K context.

desc.zh-CN: InternLM2是第二代浦语模型，InternLM2 包含两种模型规格：7B 和 20B
desc.en-US: The second generation of the InternLM model, InternLM2, includes models at two scales: 7B and 20B.

desc.zh-CN: 当前基础模型已经稳定训练了大规模高质量且多样化的数据，覆盖多语言（当前绝大部分以中文和英文为主），总量高达3万亿token。在相关基准评测中，Qwen系列模型拿出非常有竞争力的表现，显著超出同规模模型并紧追一系列最强的闭源模型。此外，我们利用SFT和RLHF技术实现对齐，从基座模型训练得到对话模型。Qwen-Chat具备聊天、文字创作、摘要、信息抽取、翻译等能力，同时还具备一定的代码生成和简单数学推理的能力。在此基础上，我们针对LLM对接外部系统等方面针对性地做了优化，当前具备较强的工具调用能力，以及最近备受关注的Code Interpreter的能力和扮演Agent的能力。
desc.en-US: In brief, we have strong base language models, which have been stably pretrained for up to 3 trillion tokens of multilingual data with a wide coverage of domains, languages (with a focus on Chinese and English), etc. They are able to achieve competitive performance on benchmark datasets. Additionally, we have chat models that are aligned with human preference based on SFT and RLHF (not released yet), which are able to chat, create content, extract information, summarize, translate, code, solve math problems, and so on, and are able to use tools, play as agents, or even play as code interpreters, etc.

desc.zh-CN: deepseek-llm-7b-chat 是一个 670 亿参数的模型，它以 deepseek-llm-67b-base 作为初始化，并在额外的指令数据集上进行了微调。
desc.en-US: deepseek-llm-67b-chat is a 67B parameter model initialized from deepseek-llm-67b-base and fine-tuned on extra instruction data.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen1.5 是 Qwen2 的测试版，保持了作为仅解码器的变换模型架构，拥有 SwiGLU 激活函数、 RoPE 和多头注意力机制，拥有六种模型大小，增强了多语言和聊天模型能力，支持 32768 令牌的上下文长度，所有模型均启用了系统提示以实现角色扮演，代码支持 transformers 原生实现。
desc.en-US: Qwen1.5 is the beta version of Qwen2, maintaining its architecture as a decoder-only transformer model with SwiGLU activation, RoPE, and multi-head attention mechanisms. It offers six model sizes and has enhanced multilingual and chat model capabilities, supporting a context length of 32,768 tokens. All models have enabled system prompts for roleplaying, and the code supports native implementation in transformers.

desc.zh-CN: Nanbeige2-8B （南北阁2-8B）是 BOSS 直聘 南北阁大模型实验室研发的第二代 80 亿参数规模的大语言模型
desc.en-US: Nanbeige2-8B is the second generation large language model developed by the Nanbeige Lab of BOSS Zhipin, with 8 billion parameters.

desc.zh-CN: Nanbeige-16B（南北阁-16B）是 BOSS 直聘 南北阁大模型实验室研发的160亿参数规模的大语言模型，采用了2.5T Tokens进行预训练，数据包含大量互联网高质量语料、各类书籍、代码等领域脱敏文本，在各个权威测评数据集上都取得了不错的效果。
desc.en-US: Nanbeige-16B is a 16 billion parameter language model developed by Nanbeige LLM Lab. It uses 2.5T Tokens for pre-training. The training data includes a large amount of high-quality internet corpus, various books, code, etc. It has achieved good results on various authoritative evaluation data sets.

desc.zh-CN: Mixtral-8x7B 大型语言模型（LLM）是一个预训练生成式的稀疏专家混合模型。在我们进行的大多数基准测试中，Mistral-8x7B 在性能上优于 Llama 2 70B。
desc.en-US: The Mixtral-8x7B Large Language Model (LLM) is a pretrained generative Sparse Mixture of Experts. The Mistral-8x7B outperforms Llama 2 70B on most benchmarks we tested.

desc.zh-CN: 通义千问-7B（Qwen-7B）是阿里云研发的通义千问大模型系列的70亿参数规模的模型。Qwen-7B是基于Transformer的大语言模型, 在超大规模的预训练数据上进行训练得到。预训练数据类型多样，覆盖广泛，包括大量网络文本、专业书籍、代码等。同时，在Qwen-7B的基础上，我们使用对齐机制打造了基于大语言模型的AI助手Qwen-7B-Chat。
desc.en-US: Qwen-7B is the 7B-parameter version of the large language model series, Qwen (abbr. Tongyi Qianwen), proposed by Aibaba Cloud. Qwen-7B`is a Transformer-based large language model, which is pretrained on a large volume of data, including web texts, books, codes, etc. Additionally, based on the pretrained Qwen-7B, we release Qwen-7B-Chat, a large-model-based AI assistant, which is trained with alignment techniques.

desc.zh-CN: ChatGLM3 是智谱AI和清华大学 KEG 实验室联合发布的新一代对话预训练模型。ChatGLM3-6B 是 ChatGLM3 系列中的开源模型，在保留了前两代模型对话流畅、部署门槛低等众多优秀特性的基础上，ChatGLM3-6B 拥有更强大的基础模型，更完整的功能支持和更全面的开源序列。
desc.en-US: ChatGLM3 is a new generation of pre-trained conversational models jointly released by Zhisp AI and Tsinghua University's KEG Lab. ChatGLM3-6B is the open-source model in the ChatGLM3 series. While retaining the smooth conversation and low deployment threshold of the previous two generations, ChatGLM3-6B boasts a more powerful base model, more complete functional support, and a more comprehensive open-source sequence.

desc.zh-CN: Yi系列模型是由01.AI的开发者从头开始训练的大型语言模型。首次公开发布包括两个双语（英语/中文）基础模型，参数规模分别为60亿和340亿。这两个模型都采用了4000个序列长度进行训练，并且在推理时可以扩展到32000个序列长度。
desc.en-US: The Yi series models are large language models trained from scratch by developers at 01.AI. The first public release contains two bilingual (English/Chinese) base models with the parameter sizes of 6B and 34B. Both of them are trained with 4K sequence length and can be extended to 32K during inference time.

desc.zh-CN: Baichuan 2 是百川智能推出的新一代开源大语言模型，采用 2.6 万亿 Tokens 的高质量语料训练，在权威的中文和英文 benchmark 上均取得同尺寸最好的效果。本次发布包含有 7B、13B 的 Base 和 Chat 版本，并提供了 Chat 版本的 4bits 量化，所有版本不仅对学术研究完全开放，开发者也仅需邮件申请并获得官方商用许可后，即可以免费商用。
desc.en-US: Baichuan 2 is the new generation of large-scale open-source language models launched by Baichuan Intelligence inc.. It is trained on a high-quality corpus with 2.6 trillion tokens and has achieved the best performance in authoritative Chinese and English benchmarks of the same size. This release includes 7B and 13B versions for both Base and Chat models, along with a 4bits quantized version for the Chat model. All versions are fully open to academic research, and developers can also use them for free in commercial applications after obtaining an official commercial license through email request.

desc.zh-CN: WizardLM-70B 是一个 700 亿参数的大语言模型
desc.en-US: WizardLM-70B is a large language model with 70 billion parameters.

desc.zh-CN: Llama-2-Chat 是在Llama-2上经过微调的大语言模型，并针对对话用例进行了优化。 在我们测试的大多数基准上，Llama-2-Chat 模型的表现优于开源聊天模型，并且在对有用性和安全性的人工评估中，与 ChatGPT 和 PaLM 等一些流行的闭源模型相当。
desc.en-US: Llama-2-Chat are finetuned LLMs and optimized for dialogue use cases. Llama-2-Chat models outperform open-source chat models on most benchmarks we tested, and in our human evaluations for helpfulness and safety, are on par with some popular closed-source models like ChatGPT and PaLM.

desc.zh-CN: deepseek-llm-7b-chat 是一个 70 亿参数的模型，它以 deepseek-llm-7b-base 作为初始化，并在额外的指令数据集上进行了微调。
desc.en-US: deepseek-llm-7b-chat is a 7B parameter model initialized from deepseek-llm-7b-base and fine-tuned on extra instruction data.

desc.zh-CN: Baichuan 2 是百川智能推出的新一代开源大语言模型，采用 2.6 万亿 Tokens 的高质量语料训练，在权威的中文和英文 benchmark 上均取得同尺寸最好的效果。本次发布包含有 7B、13B 的 Base 和 Chat 版本，并提供了 Chat 版本的 4bits 量化，所有版本不仅对学术研究完全开放，开发者也仅需邮件申请并获得官方商用许可后，即可以免费商用。
desc.en-US: Baichuan 2 is the new generation of large-scale open-source language models launched by Baichuan Intelligence inc.. It is trained on a high-quality corpus with 2.6 trillion tokens and has achieved the best performance in authoritative Chinese and English benchmarks of the same size. This release includes 7B and 13B versions for both Base and Chat models, along with a 4bits quantized version for the Chat model. All versions are fully open to academic research, and developers can also use them for free in commercial applications after obtaining an official commercial license through email request.

desc.zh-CN: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 大型语言模型（LLM）是 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 的改进指导精调版本。
desc.en-US: The Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 Large Language Model (LLM) is an improved instruct fine-tuned version of Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1.

desc.zh-CN: Vicuna 是通过在 ShareGPT 上收集的用户共享对话进行 Llama 2 微调训练的聊天助手。
desc.en-US: Vicuna is a chat assistant trained by fine-tuning Llama 2 on user-shared conversations collected from ShareGPT.

desc.zh-CN: WizardLM-13B 是一个 130 亿参数的大语言模型
desc.en-US: WizardLM-13B is a large language model with 13 billion parameters.

desc.zh-CN: Zephyr是一系列被训练成为有用助手的语言模型。Zephyr-7B-β是该系列的第二个模型，是对mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1的微调版本，该版本通过使用直接偏好优化（DPO）在公开可用的合成数据集上进行训练。
desc.en-US: Zephyr is a series of language models that are trained to act as helpful assistants. Zephyr-7B-β is the second model in the series, and is a fine-tuned version of mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 that was trained on on a mix of publicly available, synthetic datasets using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

desc.zh-CN: Llama-2-Chat 是在Llama-2上经过微调的大语言模型，并针对对话用例进行了优化。 在我们测试的大多数基准上，Llama-2-Chat 模型的表现优于开源聊天模型，并且在对有用性和安全性的人工评估中，与 ChatGPT 和 PaLM 等一些流行的闭源模型相当。
desc.en-US: Llama-2-Chat are finetuned LLMs and optimized for dialogue use cases. Llama-2-Chat models outperform open-source chat models on most benchmarks we tested, and in our human evaluations for helpfulness and safety, are on par with some popular closed-source models like ChatGPT and PaLM.

desc.zh-CN: Vicuna 是通过在 ShareGPT 上收集的用户共享对话进行 Llama 2 微调训练的聊天助手。
desc.en-US: Vicuna is a chat assistant trained by fine-tuning Llama 2 on user-shared conversations collected from ShareGPT.
